findings.title: Stats page shows results for an older date range when responses arrive out of order
findings.expected: After changing From to 2026-06-01 and then to 2026-08-01, the page shows stats from 1 Aug 2026
findings.actual: The slower first response arrives last and replaces the newer one. The From field reads 2026-08-01, but the page shows '5 harvests from 1 Jun 2026 to 31 Dec 2026' and the June column

findings.title: Stats page crashes with an uncaught TypeError when the stats response is missing fields
findings.expected: An error message, with no uncaught exception
findings.actual: Uncaught 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')'. The page stays on 'Loading stats…' and keeps showing the old table

findings.title: When loading fails, the stats page still shows the old range summary next to the error
findings.expected: When the request for the new range fails, only the error shows, with no claim about the data
findings.actual: With From set to 2026-07-01 and a 500 response, the page shows 'Injected 500' and also '5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026', a range the user is no longer looking at
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Injected 500"],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Injected 500","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]} | {"alerts":["5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Injected 500"],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Injected 500","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}

findings.title: A stats request that never answers leaves 'Loading stats…' on screen forever over the old range's data
findings.expected: The request times out with an error, or the page offers a retry
findings.actual: 13 s after changing From, the page still shows 'Loading stats…' with the previous range's table below it. No error appears and there is no way to retry
